description: This file defines the ReviewerGroup entity class for the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It models reviewer groups with properties such as id, name, and priority, and manages a many-to-many relationship with Reviewer entities.

classes.name: ReviewerGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a reviewer group with properties like id, name, priority, and associated reviewers.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for the reviewer group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the reviewer group.

methods.name: getPiority
methods.description: Returns the priority of the reviewer group.

methods.name: setPiority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the reviewer group.
